attention.why: "Put the query back" acts only after the query has moved, so the script moves the query first.
attention.script: const h = document.getElementById("att-handle"); for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) h.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent("keydown", { key: "ArrowRight", bubbles: true }))

diffusion-noising.why: "Linear" and "Cosine" agree at step 0, so the script moves the step slider to 500 first.
diffusion-noising.script: const s = document.getElementById("dn-t"); s.value = "500"; s.dispatchEvent(new Event("input", { bubbles: true }))
